phase_policies.applies_when: Early game (~3 min) with own ground-oriented macro posture, moderate production, heavy tech; opponent shows ground posture with heavy production and economy, possible pressure, or unknown posture with Marines, heavy economy, moderate production, heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when opponent's composition or pressure becomes clearer, or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop tech/economy, strengthen ground, maintain defense, keep scouting.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing technology and economy while strengthening a flexible ground army; increase production and tech, maintain defense, and keep expansion options open.
phase_policies.title: Tech/Economy Foundation with Ground Flexibility
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech or economy at the expense of scouting and defensive readiness; avoid neglecting army production if pressure is imminent.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame (~5-6 min) with own ground army including Zealots and Stalkers, heavy production and tech; opponent shows ground posture with Siege Tanks and Marines, heavy economy and production.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when opponent's tech path or army composition becomes clearer, or when you reach a critical mass.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, increase production/tech, maintain economy/defense, add utility units.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increasing production and tech; maintain economy growth and defense; consider adding Sentries or Immortals for utility.
phase_policies.title: Ground Reinforcement with Utility Additions
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend economy without proper defense; avoid neglecting army composition upgrades or scouting for tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame (~9 min) with own ground army including Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals; opponent shows ground posture with Marines and Marauders, heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when opponent's composition changes or when you are ready to take a decisive engagement.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, use Sentries/Immortals, maintain economy/expansion, keep scouting.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army, increase production and tech; use Sentries for force fields and Immortals for tanky units; maintain economy and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Consolidation with Splash and Utility
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting for tech switches or fail to prepare splash against Marine-heavy armies; avoid overcommitting to a single composition without flexibility.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame (~10 min) with own ground army including Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals; opponent shows ground posture with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, Hellions, heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when opponent's army composition shifts or when you are ready to attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground, increase production/tech, consider Phoenixes, watch for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Maintain and strengthen ground army, continue increasing production and tech; consider adding Phoenixes for map control and to handle any air transitions.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Consolidation with Air Transition Readiness
phase_policies.veto: Do not become too passive and neglect air defense if opponent transitions to air; avoid overcommitting to ground-only without scouting for air.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
